markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Gianni Infantino leaves from being President of FIFA in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role. If the role otherwise ceases to exist with no plausible successor, the contract may resolve to "No."

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if formal charges are filed.
markets.rules_primary: If Letitia James has been formally charged with a federal crime  after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Charges filed in military courts are included. The reinstatement of charges filed prior to Issuance does not count; only the filing of a new charging document after Issuance triggers the Payout Criterion.

Formal charges require the filing of a criminal complaint, information, or indictment with an appropriate court. Arrests without charges, being named as a target of investigation, civil lawsuits, and administrative actions do not constitute charges. Traffic violations that don't require court appearances and sealed charges that remain sealed through the deadline also don't count. If charges are filed and then dismissed before the deadline, the market still resolves to Yes. Pre-trial diversion agreements involving formal charges count as charges. For groups of individuals, charges against any member of the specified group trigger the criterion.
markets.title: Will Letitia James be charged with a any crime before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves retatrutide (LY3437943) for marketing before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves retatrutide (LY3437943) after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jan 1, 2027.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves retatrutide (LY3437943) anyway before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to Yes.

If retatrutide (LY3437943) receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jan 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No immediately.
markets.subtitle: Before Jan 1, 2027

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves any psychedelic substance for medical use for marketing before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Psychedelic drugs include: LSD, Psilocybin, DMT, Mescaline, MDMA, MDA, PCP, DXM, Ibogaine, Salvia divinorum, 2C family, and Ayahuasca.

Important information: For purposes of this Contract:

The listed substances are illustrative, not exhaustive. Approval of any other substance commonly recognized in scientific or FDA documentation as a psychedelic, hallucinogen, or entactogen (for example, psilocin, 5-MeO-DMT, methylone, or 2C-, DOx-, or NBOMe-family compounds) may also satisfy the Payout Criterion.

"Approval for medical use" means an FDA approval letter for an NDA or BLA authorizing marketing of a drug or biologic for human medical use in the United States, where a listed (or otherwise qualifying) psychedelic substance is an active pharmaceutical ingredient of the approved product. Complete Response Letters, tentative approvals, Emergency Use Authorizations, expanded access or compassionate use authorizations, and approvals limited to export do not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

Combination products. Approval of a combination drug product satisfies the Payout Criterion only if at least one active ingredient is a listed (or otherwise qualifying) psychedelic substance and that psychedelic active ingredient has not previously been approved by the FDA via NDA or BLA for any human medical indication. By way of example, an FDA approval of AXS-05 (a combination of dextromethorphan and bupropion) for a new indication does not satisfy the Payout Criterion, because both active ingredients were FDA-approved prior to Issuance.

New indications for previously-approved substances. An FDA approval (including via supplemental NDA or supplemental BLA) of a new medical indication, dosage, or formulation for a substance whose active pharmaceutical ingredient was already approved by the FDA via NDA or BLA prior to Issuance does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If the value of Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) is at least $54,000 in from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the value of the Dow Jones Industrial Average as reported by the Trading View, using the index's natively published level in its own currency and units; no currency conversion is applied. It is sufficient for the index to reach or exceed $54,000 at any single point from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026 for the market to resolve to Yes — the level does not need to be sustained. If the index does not reach $54,000 at any point from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026, the market resolves to No. Revisions to the underlying made after expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value. 

If no data is available from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026 by the Expiration Date, all strikes other than "No data" or "None" resolve to No. The index level is evaluated to two decimal places unless otherwise specified.

markets.rules_secondary:
Only a public announcement by the person or their official campaign that they are running counts, and it must be reported by a Source Agency. A run for any party's nomination, or as an independent or third-party candidate, counts.

Forming an exploratory committee, or saying they are interested in or considering a run
Reports about their plans that do not come from them or their campaign

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Sam Altman has testified in front of Congress after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Payout criteria
For the purposes of this Contract, "testified" means that Sam Altman appeared before Congress (in-person, remotely, or virtually), was sworn in or affirmed, or otherwise appeared in an official proceeding where testimony was compelled or authorized by the committee, and provided substantive answers to questions regarding the subject matter of the hearing.

markets.rules_primary: If Elon Musk or Tesla or SpaceX has taken or announced it is taking a stake of above 0% in Ryanair before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: A stake announced before the deadline counts, even if the deal closes after it. Taking a stake means acquiring direct equity ownership, voting shares, or equivalent ownership interests. This includes indirect ownership through wholly controlled investment vehicles and convertible rights treated as equity. Pre-existing stakes count toward the threshold. Ownership is aggregated across all share classes and listings. Crossing the threshold at any point satisfies the criterion regardless of subsequent changes. important_info.markdown:
**Important information:** To satisfy the Payout Criterion, Anthropic must release to the public a model named "Mythos." Both conditions must be met by the same model:

Name. The model must be named "Mythos" (e.g., "Claude Mythos 5"). Public release. A release restricted to a closed beta or to a limited set of approved or trusted organizations does not constitute a release to the public. A release available to the general public, including a release limited to a paid subscription tier, does constitute a release to the public.

markets.rules_primary: If legislation that reduces the federal taxes individuals owe on long-term capital gains by changing how those gains are taxed or calculated has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: A qualifying change does not need to apply to all taxpayers or all long-term capital gains. Legislation qualifies if it directly reduces or eliminates federal tax owed on long-term capital gains for individuals generally or for a defined class of taxpayers or gains, whether through a rate reduction, exemption or exclusion, a change in applicable thresholds, a change in how basis or gains are calculated, or another statutory mechanism. Changes that only defer when tax is paid, or that reduce a taxpayer’s overall federal tax liability without specifically changing the taxation or calculation of long-term capital gains, do not qualify. A qualifying change may be temporary and need not take effect before the specified deadline, provided the legislation becomes law within the specified time period.

markets.rules_primary: If Canada repeals its federal carbon pricing regime under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act, including both the fuel charge and the Output-Based Pricing System, before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
"Carbon tax" means the federal carbon pricing regime under the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act, which has two parts: the fuel charge and the Output-Based Pricing System for large industrial emitters. Both parts must be repealed for this market to resolve to Yes.
A repeal is any final, binding legislative, administrative or judicial action that ends the carbon tax. An action that sets a future date on which the carbon tax permanently ends counts, even if that date is after Jan 1, 2027.
Provincial and territorial carbon pricing is not part of the federal carbon tax.

The following do NOT count:
Repealing only the fuel charge, as Bill C-4 did (Royal Assent Mar 12, 2026).
A temporary suspension, a rate cut, or a replacement with another instrument that keeps a price on carbon.

markets.rules_primary: If the total snowfall in Boston in December 2026 is strictly greater than 12 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Snowfall data is available through The Weather Company’s dashboard at https://weather.com/kalshi. Select “Snowfall,” choose the city and station specified in this market’s rules, and use “Custom” to select the specified calendar period. Snowfall is reported in inches for each station’s local calendar day.

Not all weather data is the same. Forecasts and other weather websites may report different figures. Preliminary readings may change, and displayed totals may be incomplete when daily reports are missing. Resolution uses initial non-preliminary official values reported by The Weather Company, subject to the contract’s source hierarchy, correction, trace, and contingency provisions.

markets.rules_primary: If Trump's Executive Order 14418 takes full nationwide effect for all people it covers after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency, that A) explicitly states the full nationwide taking effect of Trump's Executive Order 14418 for all people it covers before January 1, 2027 occurred, is true, or has been verified, B) based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

Full nationwide effect means federal agencies may legally implement EO 14418 throughout the United States for every covered category. Signing, publication, guidance, or partial applicability does not qualify. Any continuing federal block for a covered person, category, territory, or jurisdiction prevents Yes. A later block does not undo an earlier qualifying period.

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA's decision on BBP-418 by Ml Bio Solutions Inc. in 2026 is a full approval or an accelerated approval, the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market will resolve to No if the FDA's decision is a denial (CRL issued), a withdrawal by the sponsor, or a conditional approval — or if no decision is issued.

BBP-418 (also known by its chemical name ribitol) is an experimental oral small-molecule drug being developed by BridgeBio to treat a rare inherited muscle disease called limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I (LGMD2I/R9). Think of it like a missing ingredient in a factory: the disease prevents muscle cells from attaching a critical sugar coating to a key protective protein, and BBP-418 supplies the raw material the factory needs to get that process running again. It is taken orally and was shown in the FORTIFY trial to significantly boost levels of the properly-coated protein in patients, which appears to translate into meaningful improvements in muscle and lung function.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the function is implemented.
markets.rules_primary: If an Anthropic product has implemented a general-purpose personal AI agent that remembers the user and starts multi-step tasks across third-party apps on its own before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The function must be live and processing user interactions, not explicitly labeled as "beta," "test," "experimental," "preview," or "early access" or similar, and officially acknowledged by the company through announcements, documentation, or help pages. Implementation includes direct integration into the product's interface, automatic application to user accounts, user-initiated activation through official controls, API implementation, or policy changes that operationally enforce the function. Announcements without deployment, employee-only testing, technical documentation without implementation, and third-party additions without authorization do not qualify. The implementation must occur in the United States unless otherwise specified. If it meets these conditions, it counts from the first date it is live for users outside the company, including in a gradual rollout or a waitlist, invitation-only, or paid-tier release.

A general-purpose personal AI agent acts for an individual user on that user's own goals, is not limited to a single category of task or app, such as only code, only documents, or only shopping, and (1) retains user-specific information, such as preferences, relationships, goals, or ongoing activities, across separate interactions, and (2) as a built-in capability, on its own initiative and outside any conversation or task the user has started, begins new multi-step actions across third-party apps, websites, or services to advance the user's ongoing goals, based on what it has retained. The agent must itself take at least one such action before asking the user anything, and may then pause for approval before a step such as sending a message or making a purchase. An action means changing something in a third-party app, website, or service on the user's behalf, such as sending, posting, booking, purchasing, submitting a form, or creating, editing, or deleting an item; reading, searching, or summarizing does not count. An agent focused on work qualifies if it acts across email, calendar, messaging, and the web for an individual user.

The following do not qualify: carrying out a task the user started, however long-running; running tasks on a user-defined schedule, event trigger, or monitor, or under a standing instruction that tells the agent what to do or which app, source, or workflow to watch; a briefing or notification on its own; a proposed task or suggestion that does nothing until the user accepts it; an offer made in reply to the user's message; memory alone; an agent configured by an organization to run shared team workflows; and a developer platform, SDK, or API for building agents, unless the company itself offers through it an agent that meets (1) and (2) for end users. A goal or preference the user has shared, from which the agent itself decides what new task to start, is not a standing instruction, and neither is turning the capability on, connecting apps, or granting permissions.

markets.rules_primary: If any company announces an agreement to acquire Cordis before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The announcement must involve a definitive, binding agreement accompanied by public announcement. Letters of intent, memoranda of understanding, or agreements in principle do not qualify. The deal does not need to close as long as an agreement has been announced. Regulatory blocking or later cancellation does not affect resolution. Cross-border transactions qualify if a definitive agreement is announced. Internal reorganizations, joint ventures, or minority investments do not qualify unless they involve controlling ownership transfer. The acquisition can be structured as asset purchases, stock purchases, tender offers, SPAC combinations, or takeover agreements. Transactions involving subsidiaries qualify, but those limited solely to assets or divisions must represent the majority of operations or equity control.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of Education announces a decision by the senior Department official to terminate, suspend, limit, or deny renewal of the recognition of the American Bar Association's Council of the Section of Legal Education and Admissions to the Bar as an accrediting agency for law schools before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The decision must be made by the senior Department official, the Education Department official designated by the Secretary to decide accreditor recognition under 34 CFR 602.3, or by the Secretary. It counts when announced, even if later appealed or stayed.

A NACIQI recommendation, a staff finding, a notice inviting the Council to respond before a decision, and recognition of a competing accreditor do not qualify. Continuing the Council's recognition does not resolve the market to Yes, including where recognition continues with a monitoring report, compliance report, shortened term, conditions, or a scope revision.

markets.rules_primary: If the daily published par yield for the 30Y U.S. Treasury is above 5.29% on any business day between Sep 17, 2026 and Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: This market covers the period between Sep 17, 2026 and Jan 1, 2027. Resolution is based solely on the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rate for the 30Y tenor as published by the U.S. Department of the Treasury for each business day in this period; intraday values are not considered. The first published value for each business day governs unless the Exchange determines a material error prior to that strike's expiration. If the threshold is met, the market may expire early in accordance with Rule 7.2. Otherwise, the market will expire by 7:00 PM ET on the first business day after the final daily value of the period is published, or one week after the period ends, whichever comes first.

markets.rules_primary: If any federal or state court issues a temporary restraining order, preliminary or permanent injunction, or judgment that enjoins enforcement of all or part of California Assembly Bill 1709, signed September 10, 2026 in a case challenging California Assembly Bill 1709, including Meta Platforms, Inc. v. Bonta, No. 3:26-cv-13201 (N.D. Cal.), Google LLC v. Bonta, No. 5:26-cv-13204 (N.D. Cal.), and TikTok Inc. v. Bonta, No. 2:26-cv-12965 (C.D. Cal.) before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by any federal or state court in a case challenging California Assembly Bill 1709, including Meta Platforms, Inc. v. Bonta, No. 3:26-cv-13201 (N.D. Cal.), Google LLC v. Bonta, No. 5:26-cv-13204 (N.D. Cal.), and TikTok Inc. v. Bonta, No. 2:26-cv-12965 (C.D. Cal.)
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

Partial relief counts. A written order whose operative terms enjoin enforcement of Assembly Bill 1709 only as applied to one or more plaintiffs or platforms, or only some of its provisions, qualifies even if it is interim or limited in scope. A temporary restraining order qualifies when it is issued in writing, and it need not be converted or extended into a preliminary injunction. A qualifying ruling counts when issued, even if it is later stayed, vacated, or reversed.

An order that concerns only the Protecting Our Kids from Social Media Addiction Act (Senate Bill 976 of 2024) does not qualify.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
An agreement or stipulation not to enforce the law, even if entered as an order of the court
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

markets.early_close_condition: After the calendar month has ended, this market may expire once the monthly snowfall figure is available, subject to the contract's expiration, material-error, and review provisions.
markets.rules_primary: If the total snowfall accumulated at Big Sky Resort, Montana during December 2026, in inches, as reported by OnTheSnow, is strictly greater than 5 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the total snowfall accumulated at Big Sky Resort, Montana during the calendar month of December 2026, measured in inches and reported by OnTheSnow.

Use OnTheSnow's monthly snowfall figure for that month in the 2026-27 season on the historical-snowfall page at https://www.onthesnow.com/montana/big-sky-resort/historical-snowfall as the published measurement of that calendar-month accumulation. The reported figure must correspond to the specified month and season.

After the calendar month has ended and the monthly figure is available, the market resolves to Yes if the reported total is strictly greater than 5 inches, and to No if it is equal to or below that threshold. Use the initial non-preliminary reported value, subject to the contract's material-error, correction, expiration, and market-outcome-review provisions.

The latest expiration is 10:00 AM ET one week after the final day of the calendar month. If the monthly figure is unavailable at that deadline, apply the contract's data-unavailability and contingency provisions. The existing settlement timer applies.

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump makes at least 1 statement explicitly calling for Jensen Huang to be reinstated as CEO of Nvidia before Nov 18, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A statement qualifies if it clearly says that Jensen Huang should be reinstated, brought back, or returned as CEO of Nvidia, or that Donald Trump wants him back as CEO, such as "Nvidia should bring Jensen back" or "I want Jensen back." Exact wording is not required, and a call directed at Nvidia, its board, or Huang counts. Spoken remarks, including interviews and remarks to reporters, count. Reinstatement is not required.

Conditional, hypothetical, or tentative remarks do NOT count, such as "I'd like to see him back," "maybe they'll bring him back," or saying Huang should return if a condition is met. Praise of Huang or criticism of his departure or of Nvidia's board alone does NOT count.

Statements must be affirmatively issued or signed; being quoted in another’s statement does not count. Retweets, reposts, or shares without additional commentary do not count as statements.

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump makes at least 1 statement explicitly calling for or endorsing a global pause, pacing, or slowdown in frontier AI development before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Pause, pacing, and slowdown include a temporary halt or a deliberate reduction in the rate of frontier AI research, training, or capability development; a complete halt is not required. Frontier AI means leading general-purpose AI systems and development of their successors. The call must concern development generally on a worldwide basis or through coordinated action across countries. Calls restricted to one sector or application, such as biology, or to one country do NOT qualify.

An explicit endorsement of a qualifying proposal counts, including a proposal conditional on reciprocal participation or safeguards. Merely describing, considering, or quoting a proposal without endorsing its slowdown component does NOT count.
